title: Ways to Hit the Total
statement:
You have `n` coins with positive values. Choose any group of coins (possibly a single coin) whose values add up to exactly `S`. Two groups are different if they use different coins, even when the coins have equal values. Count the groups.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `S`. The second line contains the `n` values.

## Output
Print the number of groups whose values sum to exactly `S`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16`
- `1 <= a_i <= 100`
- `1 <= S <= 1600`
